findings.one_line: The proposal's unconditional all-policy minimax frontier is not delivered: this theorem is explicitly conditional on the unresolved no-loss certificate, while the proved kernel is only the one-design upper certificate.

The current theorem-level positioning does not identify the closest published upper-bound result and state precisely, at theorem level, what its finite-horizon polynomial-envelope certificate adds beyond that result; the general related-work paragraph is not a substitute for this comparison.
